story.fullStory:
Gloriana's "Can't Shake You" reached #83 on the Billboard Hot 100. Gloriana was an American country music group founded in 2008 by Cheyenne Kimball (vocals, mandolin), Rachel Reinert (vocals), and brothers Tom Gossin (vocals, guitar) and Mike Gossin (vocals, guitar).

The song peaked at #83 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 4 weeks on the chart.

Can't Shake You was released in 2012.

Album: A Thousand Miles Left Behind (2012).
